notes: Official NYS DEC database of licensed wildlife rehabilitators, searchable by county and species. Only DEC-licensed rehabbers may legally handle wild animals; most wildlife cannot legally be kept. Not all rehabbers can accept every animal - try the next-nearest listing if one is full.
